set.body:
Phase D (architecture). Adopts the reviewer's refinement over the original proposal.

Model:
    PreparedJob[A]     = LaunchSpec + ResultPlan[A] + content digest
    PreparedAttempt[A] = PreparedJob[A] + attempt identity + epoch

The split matters: it separates REUSABLE prepared content from ATTEMPT-SPECIFIC identity, so a new attempt is not baked into a reusable workload definition, while the result envelope retains its authority.

- Preparation produces a launch specification plus ResultPlan[A].
- A durable attempt binds that plan to submission key, epoch, operation, schema and launch digest.
- Acceptance determines whether a typed handle can be bound, or whether only uncertainty evidence remains.

This unifies typed tasks, scripts, arrays, remote attachment and durable managed execution without a second scheduler algebra. Typed results integrate with managed attempts here — today the managed controller persists only JobRequest[NoResult], so typed results and durable execution are separate worlds.

Blocked by P8.D1 (PreparedJob binds a LaunchSpec; the type must exist first).
set.title: P8.D2: PreparedJob[A] and PreparedAttempt[A] with one persisted result plan
